## Summary

Pušis ("Pine") is a grey old wolf with a split nose who served [Kęstutis](kestutis.qmd). At the exposure of Kirmėlė in the Trakai vault he is the one who says the Word: leave him to the bog, alive. In 1399 he leads the wolves who will not cross the Dnieper into the steppe; he does not follow [Kalvis](kalvis.qmd) to the Vorskla. He stands in the Kūčios line when the wolves name [Žiežirba](flame_keeper.qmd) in 1405.

## Record vs saga

- **[Saga invention]:** All of it; the Iron Wolves are ours (D10).

## Appearances

**Book II:** ch. 11, 29. **Book III:** ch. 9.
